description: This file defines a PHP class 'PaymentAddress' in the 'Opencart' namespace, which handles API operations related to payment address management, including validation, setting session data, and retrieving address information within an OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests for managing payment address data, including validation and session storage.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Processes and validates incoming payment address data from a POST request, updates session data if valid, and returns success or error information.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment address session data based on an address ID provided, verifying ownership.
